en-US.description: A high-performance, local-first, cross-platform clipboard manager.
en-US.longDescription: Clipboard Desktop is a high-performance, cross-platform, local-first clipboard manager. It quietly runs in the background and keeps recording your clipboard history; a global hotkey (Alt+V by default) summons the launcher with full-text search (including Chinese word segmentation), image OCR text recognition, favorites, editing, and quick paste. It handles four content types — text, links, images, and files — with smart content recognition, rich-text formatted paste, a Tantivy full-text search engine with N-gram Chinese tokenization, and local PP-OCR text recognition. All data stays on your machine with no telemetry or uploads, and OCR runs fully offline without network access.

zh-CN.description: 高性能 · 本地优先 · 全平台剪贴板管理器。
zh-CN.longDescription: Clipboard Desktop 是一款高性能、跨平台、本地优先的剪贴板管理工具。它在后台静默运行，持续记录剪贴板历史；通过全局热键（默认 Alt+V）一键唤起，支持全文搜索（含中文分词）、图片 OCR 文字识别、收藏、编辑、快速粘贴等操作。支持文本、链接、图片、文件四种内容类型，智能内容识别与富文本带格式粘贴，Tantivy 全文检索引擎与 N-gram 中文分词，PP-OCR 本地离线文字识别。所有数据存储在本地，不包含任何遥测或上传行为，OCR 完全离线运行，无需联网。
zh-CN.name: Clipboard
